annotations.title: utilpeek: SEC EDGAR financial statements by period (revenue, income, balance sheet, cash flow)

description: utilpeek: Get a US company's reported financials per fiscal year or quarter from SEC EDGAR. For the registrant and filings use sec_company_lookup. Returns a US SEC registrant's reported financials by ticker or CIK, annual or quarterly (up to 20): revenue, income, EPS, balance sheet, cash flow, capex and shares with us-gaap tag and filing; missing metrics are null. Latest comparable filed fact wins (/A, accession, tag ties); newer excluded concepts/start dates warn in selection. Informational only, not investment advice. Data: SEC EDGAR (public domain), cached up to 6 hours; no SEC endorsement implied. Send exactly one of ticker or cik; bad input is a 422 and an unknown company or no US-GAAP data a 404 (neither charged); an upstream outage is a 503 (not charged). Typically 1-4 s (cached under 0.1 s). Price: USD 0.005. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/sec-financials-api.html

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, 1-10 digits, as a number or a string (leading zeros and a CIK prefix allowed, such as 320193 or 0000320193). Send ticker or cik.
cik.title: Cik

period.description: annual: fiscal years from 10-K filings; quarterly: the discrete quarters in 10-Q filings.
period.title: Period

ticker.description: Exchange ticker such as AAPL (class shares as BRK-B, BRK.B or BRK/B). Send ticker or cik.
ticker.title: Ticker

name: sec_financials

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.

metrics.description: revenue, grossProfit, operatingIncome, netIncome, epsBasic, epsDiluted, totalAssets, totalLiabilities, stockholdersEquity, cash, operatingCashFlow, capex, sharesOutstanding

additionalProperties.description: Selection within the priority-anchored category, exact start/end and unit. Only Revenues / RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax and basic or diluted EPS / combined EPS are cross-tag economic aliases. Any observed filing reporting both revenue tags for the same dates with different values marks them as different scopes for that filer; absent scope evidence also disables that alias. Latest filed date wins; equal dates prefer /A forms, then greatest accession as a deterministic tie-break (not filing order), then tag priority; missing filing dates sort first. Excluded concepts/start dates warn only if newer by date or same-date amendment, not accession. A newer eligible alias keeps latest_comparable_fact even with warnings; otherwise a newer excluded fact gives priority_fallback. Contradictory same-tag facts in one filing retain source order with ambiguous_fact, not a new null. Cover-page shares remain matched to the first filing's accession, not the period end.

conflicts.description: Bounded warnings, not proof of a restatement: different economic concepts or starts, contradictory same-tag facts, disagreeing aliases in one filing, or ambiguous cover-page shares. Empty means none of these were observed.

selection.description: Per-metric selection reason and bounded conflict codes, keyed by metric name; does not replace the selected metric's filing provenance.
